svg.title: kilo's descriptors and its child's as the server starts: three pipes, fork, dup2, exec; at the end the child is clangd, reading 0 and writing 1, and kilo holds 4 and 5
svg.text: the descriptors open in each process after each step: a build of 07.01 that listed them

g.title: kilo alone: descriptors 0, 1 and 2 are the terminal.
Three pipe() calls: in is 3 (its read end) and 4 (its write end), out 5 and 6, err 7 and 8. FD_CLOEXEC on all six: exec will close them.
fork(): the child has a copy of every descriptor, so each pipe now has four, two in each process. The child opens /dev/null as 9.
The child dup2()s in's read end to 0, out's write end to 1 and /dev/null to 2: copies without close-on-exec. kilo closes 3, 6 and 8, the ends it does not use.
g.text: 3 to 9 stay open until exec closes them

g.title: execvp(): the child is clangd, with 0, 1 and 2 alone; exec closed 3 to 9, err's write end 8 with them, so kilo's read(7) gets 0 bytes, and kilo closes 7. kilo keeps 4 and 5.
